title.narrative: Madhya Pradesh Urban Services Improvement Project

description.narrative: The proposed Project will support government in improved and sustainable urban services to approximately 1.7 million people in 64 towns of the State (geographic coverage), improved institutional and financial management capacity of benefitting urban local bodies, and the development and operationalization of the Madhya Pradesh Urban Development Company Limited . The proposed Project will be implemented over 5 years from 2017 through 2022 (time slice).

(i) Loan 3528-IND: Target- 400 persons from MPUDC and ULB
(ii) Loan 3974-IND: Target - 400 persons from MPUDC and ULB
Achievements: A total of 748 officials and community representatives (including 309 women) from UDHD, MPUDC, ULBs, and service utilities were trained through 64 trainings, workshops, and webinars conducted across Phase I and Phase AF. These capacity-building programs focused on managing and monitoring DBO performance-based contracts, gender-responsive urban service delivery, and service sustainability. Training content covered O&M of WSS services, citywide inclusive sanitation, DBO contracts, social issues, financial sustainability, and the GESI action plan.
Data Source: Quarterly project progress report, PPMS, and Project Completion Report Actual value:
